name: Nurgle Rituals
notes: Used by the Carnival Master (and by Marauders Seers of Onogal, who replace Daemonic Vigour with Touch of Onogal, see chaos-marks). Roll D6. Judgement call: Daemonic Aura save 5+ -> 4+ converted to 9+ -> 7+, Scabrous Hide 2+ -> 3+; Toughness tests left as written. The Blessings of Nurgle page (Tainted Ones) is not a spell list and is omitted.

spells.name: Daemonic Vigour
spells.text: Plague Bearers or Nurglings within 8" of the Master improve their Daemonic Aura save from 9+ to 7+ until the beginning of their next turn.

spells.name: Buboes
spells.text: Range 8", one enemy warrior. Must pass a Toughness test or lose a Wound. No armour saves.

spells.name: Stench of Nurgle
spells.text: Range 6", all living creatures, friend or foe. Each enemy warrior in range must pass a Toughness test or lose an Attack until their next turn.

spells.name: Pestilence
spells.text: All enemy models within 12" of the Master suffer a Strength 6 hit. No armour saves.

spells.name: Scabrous Hide
spells.text: The Master has a 3+ armour save which replaces any normal armour save. Lasts until the beginning of his next Shooting phase.

spells.name: Nurgle's Rot
spells.text: All enemy models in base contact with the Master must immediately test against their Toughness or contract Nurgle's Rot.
